description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You're damaged by an enemy's attack.

Preserving your time is the most important thing you can do. You summon a primal form of desperation to protect yourself. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level rounded up that last for 1 round. You can immediately Stride up to your Speed but must end your movement further away from the triggering enemy.
